context:
Wired 5 findings from Reddit/X/Twitter research into all DGX Spark scripts for launch day tomorrow.

FINDINGS WIRED:
1. DenseMixer (pip install densemixer, DENSEMIXER_ENABLED=1) — precise MoE router gradients via STE, +2-4% on Qwen3 MoE. Added to spark-lora-train.sh (pip install + env var + Python heredoc import) and spark-grpo-train.sh (same in SFT warmstart + GRPO training sections).
2. min_p=0.2 + top_k=40 via --override-generation-config — fixes Qwen3.6 infinite thinking loop bug. Added to ALL vLLM serve commands: spark-maxperf.sh (BF16+FP8), superqwen3-super.sh (restart_serving BF16+FP8), deploy-spark-day1.sh (BF16+FP8), spark-grpo-train.sh (GRPO vLLM serve).
3. vLLM LoRA bug #38520 — confirmed our merge strategy bypasses it entirely (no LoRA loaded into vLLM, we merge first).
4. DFlash accept rate only 5-7.2 (not dramatic speedup, keep wired, validation catches issues).
5. FP8 port :8001 for agent inference (208 tok/s on Blackwell), BF16 :8000 for quality/training only.

BONUS BUG FIX: `export UNSLOTH_MOE_BACKEND=grouped_mm` inside python3 -c doesn't work (shell export, not Python). Changed to os.environ['UNSLOTH_MOE_BACKEND'] = 'grouped_mm' in both GRPO Python sections.

ALSO: Qwen3.6-Plus is 32.5B DENSE but API-only closed source. Can't install on Spark. The only open-weight Qwen3.6 is 35B-A3B (3B active MoE). Training IS the answer — the Super pipeline teaches the router to use all 256 experts surgically.
